Improve your balance and reduce your risk of falls with this gentle 10-minute routine designed specifically for adults over 50. Have a chair nearby for support and a pillow you can stand on for one of the exercises.
This workout takes you through 10 exercises targeting the strength, stability, and coordination that keep you steady on your feet in everyday life. Perfect for beginners, seniors, and anyone returning to exercise after a break.
10 exercises | 45 seconds each
15 seconds rest between moves
Chair-supported options throughout
Suitable for all fitness levels
